1.title: Escape from the middle of Toronto
update: 2026 RULE: This leg must be run in full by one runner (no splits).
2026: new route this year. The booklet's written directions are for the old route, so follow the turn cues and the map.

2.title: Winding through Scarborough
dir: From the Church Head northwest on Wood Glen Rd toward Kingston Rd for 45 meters
Turn right at Kingston Rd, heading northeast for 550 meters
Next turn right at Warden Ave
In 400 meters Warden turns left and becomes Crescentwood Rd.  Stay on the paved road and do not travel down the dirt path
In 400 metres Crescentwood Rd. turns left and becomes Kildonan Dr
There is a small park on the right Crescentwood Park
Follow Kildonan Dr 180 meters.  Past the first dead end street take the 2nd right (Viewbank Rd.)  There is a sign for the Waterfront Trail on a hydro pole
in 100 meters Viewbank Rd. crosses lakeside Dr and becomes Kingsbury Crescent.
In 300 meters Kingsbury Crescent turns slightly left and becomes Harding Blvd

160 meters later Turn right onto Waterfront Trail.  This is a paved portion of the trail that crosses the sidewalk.  It's the first right but doesn't look like a road from the street. There is a sign on a post.  Don't miss it!
in 100 meters the trail ends, turn left onto Birchmount Rd
Take the first quick right (32m) onto Springbank Ave
Take springbank to the very end and you will see a dirt path (if it's not snowing!)
Take the trail though the park (Harrison Properties) 180 meters of trail
after the trail you continue onto Lakehurst Crescent for another 200 meters before you hit Rosetta McClain Gardens
Rosetta McClain Gardens has a gate at the entrance
There is a fork when you enter, stay left
Turn left at the next four way trail intersection
You want to stay left but do not take any 90 degree turns or you will turn up too early
This curvy trail will meet with Glen Everest Rd
Trail section should be about 300 meters
Turn right onto Glen Everest Rd and stay on this for 160 meters
Take the first right onto Fishleigh Dr and rest easy for around 850 meters as you ride an easy down hill and then start your climbing!
Fishleigh Dr turns left and becomes Midland Ave
220 meters up Midland ave, take the first right onto Romana Dr
100 meters later Turn left onto Scarboro Crescent
70 meters take the first right onto Undercliff Dr (There is a Toronto waterfront sign)
You are on Undercliff for 300 meters, pass the park and tennis courts.  this is a dead end with a paved trail on the left into Bluffers Park.  You should be about 5KM total now.
You will take this trail, there is an exit at the top DO NOT TAKE THIS. There is a sharp right hand turn you should take before the exit. If you end up on Chine Dr turn around.
Take the trail to the T trail intersection.  Turn left at the T
Take this trail 700 meters it ends with a Seminary on the left and a fence.  You may need to climb the fence
This Bluffers Park section is 25 meter climb
After you exit the fenced in are Turn left onto Brimley Rd S
You’re on this for only 42 meters.
Take the first right onto Barkdene Hills. Take Barkdene 450 meters to the end.
turn left on Brooklawn Ave (Follow the waterfront signs) then turn take the first quick right on Broadmead Ave (Dead End Road)
in 220 meters take the 2nd left onto Neilson Ave.  If you hit the dead end you went to far.  There are signs on the hydro poles so keep your eyes peeled
Stay on Neilson for 300 meters and take the first right, Sloley Rd (again there are signs)
Soley for 450 meters
At the end of Soley Turn left onto Scarborough Heights Blvd and stay on this for 210 meters
First right on Ayre Point Rd, only 100 meters then take the first left on Fenwood Heights
Take Fenwood for 400 meters
Take the first right onto Balcarra Ave 250 meters
Take the 2nd left onto Faircroft Blvd  400 meters This will take you to Kingston Rd.  :(
9KM
Turn Right on Kingston Rd.  Fun over but only for 280 meters.
You will pass a gas station on the right (Pioneer on Google maps)
Turn down the road right just past this
Turn right on Ravine Dr  This turns into  Bellehaven Crescent.  As much as you want to, stay off the Doris MaCarthy Trail. 530 meters.
At the stop signed intersection stay on Bellehaven Crescent
Km10
Follow around the bend and it turns into Hill Crescent.

this is your last climb for about 500 meters in length.  When you see Markham Rd, it's all downhill from here.. except for your last climb up Guildwood Beach. (8m elevation) so save a bit for the last 600 meters
You are on Hill Crescent for about 1km
Watch for waterfront signs on stop signs.
You will turn a sharp right off Hill crest onto a trail.  This is right near Heathfield Rd.
this trail will come out at Heathfield Rd. but in a different location
At the T Turn left onto Sylvan Ave
Take Sylvan for 2.4km.. nice a flat
Take it all the way to the end.  Cross Livingston Rd. onto a paved trail
The trail is paved and also brick.  Follow the trail as it winds but do not Turn onto another trail.
Once you hit road.  Turn left and head out to Guildwood Parkway.
The RV should be there waiting

2026 DETOUR (around 7 km): leave the Waterfront Trail and go north on Port Union Rd

4.title: Frenchman’s Bay
dir: From the new start point, follow the Strava route to rejoin the Waterfront Trail (the bridge is closed)
In 150 meters, veer right to stay on the waterfront trail
In 260 meters, you will turn left onto Bella Vista Dr.
In 65 meters, turn right on Rodd Ave.
In 400 meters, Rodd Ave. will end and will turn into the Waterfront Trail (you will keep going straight)
You will continue along the Waterfront trail for 1.4K until you hit Marksbury Rd.
Turn left on Marksbury Rd.
In 230 meters, turn right on Surf Ave.
In 110 meters, turn right on W Shore Blvd
In 100 meters, turn left on Beachpoint Promenade
In 400 meters, turn left on to the Waterfront trail
In 300 meters veer right onto Breezy Dr. (If you veer right it’s Breezy Dr. but if you veer left it’s Sunrise Ave so don’t be worried if you see a street sign that says Sunrise Ave.)
In 240 meters, hang a right to go back on the Waterfront trail
Stay on the Waterfront trail for 500 meters and turn left onto Elvira Ct.
In 65 meters turn right on Vistula Dr.
In 270 meters, hang a right to go back onto the Waterfront trail
In 90 meters, veer right on the Waterfront trail
In 230 meters, turn right onto Bayly St.
In 700 meters, turn right on St Martins Dr.
In 230 meters, turn left on Radom St.
In 350 meters, turn right on Douglas Ave.
In 700 meters, Douglas Ave. will bend right and shortly after that bend you will turn left onto Front Rd.
In 600 meters, turn right onto Liverpool Rd.
Run along Liverpool Rd. for 400 meters
Exchange point will be by the parking lot on the left hand side of the street
update: 2026 UPDATE: Start point changed because the bridge is closed. The rest of the route is unchanged. The first step below (over the bridge) no longer applies: from the new start, follow the Strava route until you join the directions.

at intersection turn right onto Bennett Rd (550m)

end of the road turn RIGHT onto Cobbledick Road (220m)
take first left back onto Waterfront trail [ lots of twists and turns, stay on main gravel trail, cross over a river] (1.3km)

run into a residential area, 4th street is Donaldson

pass over Murry Canal/ Swing Bridge

31.title: Amherst

Turn left on Coverdale Dr. and run for 160 meters
Turn right on Bayridge Dr. and run for 2.4K
Turn left on Front Rd. and run for 3.8K (the trail is on the left side of the road)

Turn right onto West St 364 ft

Continue onto Route 2 E (the road will bend right and cross a bridge)

dir: Head east on Route 2 for the full 6.9K
Past Festubert St (?)

35.title: Grass Creek

36.title: Leeds and the Thousand Islands

210meters, left onto ELIZABETH Dr S

dir: Head east on Second St W for 2.5K
Turn right on Brookdale Ave
In 350 meters veer left to stay on Rd. 2
In 1.6K turn right on Race St.
In 450 meters turn right on Marlborough St S/Harbour Rd
In 300 meters turn right on the Waterfront Trail
Stay on the Waterfront Trail for 650 meters.
Transition zone is just past Alice Street, look out for the RV in the St Lawrence College parking lot

54.title: Cornwall 2
dir: 220 meters, Head northeast on Waterfront Trail toward St. Lawrence Dr (waterfront Trail)
120 meters Turn left onto St. Lawrence Dr (looks like a turn from the path towards the road)
3.4kms turn right onto Montreal Rd/Cornwall 2 (path is along the way)
6.8kms Continue (no actual turn, road continues) onto Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry County Road 2
6meters turn left onto Orchard RD (second Orchard Rd…do not turn on the first Orchard Rd.)
Exchange point is at the corner of County Road 2 and Orchard Rd.

55.title: Cameron’s Point
dir: Head east on Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry County Road 2 for the full 7.7K
The exchange point will be at the Charlotenburgh Park lot (if runner hits Fraser Rd.they've gone too far - should have an obvious sign for camping and picnic area) Lot is on right side of the road.

56.title: South Lancaster
dir: Head northeast on Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry County Road 2 for 5.9K
Turn right on South Service Rd. and run for 3.4K
The exchange point will be at the Glengarry campground (entrance is on the right side of the road)

57.title: Last Leg in Ontario
dir: Head northeast on S Service Rd. for 8.1K
Turn right onto County Rd. 2 and run for 2.9K
Exchange point will be at the intersection of 5th line Rd and Hwy 2 (last street before the Quebec border)

58.title: Bonjour Quebec!
dir: Head east on Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry County Road 2- 280 M
ENTERING QUEBEC
Continue onto Chemin de la Frontière/QC-338 E- 8.8 K
Turn left onto 34e Avenue- 750 M
Turn right onto 20e Rue- 400 M
Turn left onto 26e Avenue- 300 M
Exchange Point- Small lot on the left hand side of 26e Avenue (just after turning left on 26e Avenue from 20e Rue)

59.title: Canal du Soulanges 1
dir: Head east on the Waterfront Trail
In 2.9K you will reach Montee du Comte and keep going on the trail
In 750 meters the trail veers right
In 1.3K you will reach QC-338 and cross the road to get to the path along the Canal
Turn left on the Chemin de Vieux canal path
Follow the Chemin de Vieux canal path for 3.4K
You will go over a bridge and turn right at the far end of the bridge to take the Soulanges Canal Trail
Continue on the Soulanges Canal Trail for 3.3K
Transition zone will be where the canal trail meets Chemin St-Emmanuel

60.title: Canal du Soulanges 2
dir: Head northeast on Soulanges Canal Trail toward Chemin Saint-Dominique for the full 11.6K
The exchange point will be where the Soulanges Canal Trail meets Chemin St Antoine (this is a road just south of the canal – RV should be waiting at the side of the road)

61.title: 5K for Every Year
dir: From Chemin Saint-Antoine turn onto Soulanges Canal Trail, heading east (turn right from Chemin St Antoine)
In 3.1 km, turn left onto Rue Centrale
In 260 m, turn left onto Avenue des Cascades
In 130 m, turn right onto CH Lotbiniere/QC-338E
Stay on CH Lotbiniere/QC-338E for 5.8 km
Transition zone will be the fork in the road where 338 meets Avenue St Jean Baptiste

62.title: Ile Perrot
dir: Head north on St Jean Baptiste for 950 meters
Turn right on Turn right onto Autoroute du Souvenir/Autoroute 20 for 450 meters
Turn right on Avenue Sabourin and make a very quick left to get on the sidewalk that runs alongside the bridge
In 650 meters turn right on Chemin Duhamel
In 600 meters, veer left to turn onto 5e Avenue (which will turn into Grand Boulevard)
In 4.1K turn right on 1ere Avenue and run 80 meters
The exchange point will be at the side of the road on 1ere Avenue (just after the runner turns right onto 1ere Ave from Grand Boulevard)

63.title: Baie D’Urfe
dir: Head southwest 84 m on 1st Ave toward Grand Boulevard
Turn right onto Grand Boulevard
Right before the highway (autoroute) there is a path on the right side.  This will take you safely across the bridge
At the end of the bridge there is a spiral ramp going down
At the bottom you should come out ready to cross to Rue Sainte-Anne
turn right onto Rue Sainte-Anne and jump on the north side of the sidewalk (left)
After Maple Road (Rd Maple) there is a path, jump on this as the sidewalk ends.  this runs through a McGill University campus and eventually ends at a road that leads to a cemetery.
After the trail ends jump back onto lakeshore on the northside as there is a shoulder on this side only.

The road eventually splits at Beaconsfield.  there is a red fire hydrant before the split and an arrow sign telling cars to stay left.  DO NOT STAY LEFT.  YOU NEED TO CROSS TO THE SOUTH SIDE THERE To stay on lakeshore
A bit after the turn you get onto lakeshore oneway for cars and a shared foot\bike path to the end
you end at Avenue Neveu, if you pass this you'll be running up someones driveway :)

64.title: Beaconsfield
dir: head North on Avenue Neveu (200m)
Turn right onto Boulevard Beaconsfield, appears to be a major road/residential area, sidewalk available (3.3km)
Boulevard Beaconsfield becomes Chemin Lakeshore, continue on this road for 650m
Chemin Lakeshore becomes Chemin du Bord-du-Lac (lots of restaurants along this road), continue on Chemin du Bord-du-Lac for 3.4km
on the right there will be a massive parking lot on the right, look out for lot once you pass Avenue Waters Edge (street on the left)
Exchange point will be a parking lot on the south side of 5/Chemin du bord du lac/Lakeshore

65.title: Dorval
dir: Head northwest toward Chemin du Bord-du-Lac 13 ft
Turn right onto Chemin du Bord-du-Lac 1.0 mi
Continue onto Chemin Bord-du-Lac 3.1 mi
Turn right 102 ft Keep right 0.3 mi
Turn left 16 ft
Turn right 0.3 mi
Slight right 0.4 mi
Keep following the main trail until you get to the exchange point at the parking lot at Parc St Louis

66.title: Lechine Canal
dir: Head east on Boulevard Saint-Joseph (which will turn into Chemin du Musee) for 2.3K
Turn left on the Lachine Canal
In 1.9K you will turn left to cross the canal and make a quick right turn to stay on the north side of the Lachine Canal
In 4.9K you will turn right to cross the pedestrian bridge (it will be just before a big highway bridge) to get back on the south side of the canal
Make a quick left to stay on the canal path
In 2.4K turn left to cross the pedestrian bridge to get to the north side of the canal
Run 100 meters straight across the bridge
Transition zone will be at the corner of Avenue Atwater and Rue Charles Biddle

67.title: Mont Royal
dir: Head north on Avenue Atwater
In 2.3K, turn right on Avenue du Docteur-Penfield
In 180 meters, make a quick left on Chemin de la Cote des Neiges
In 80 meters, make a quick right on Avenue de Pins
In 1.7K, veer left onto Avenue du Parc
Veer onto the Chemin Olmstead path and keep following the main path up toward the lookout
At the Lac aux Castors, the rest of the team will join the last part of the leg to the finish line at the Chalet du Mont Royal Lookout
update: 2026 RULE: This leg must be run in full by one runner (no splits).
